title: Financial Assistance Policy, Section 5 — Application Period and Service Area
content:
**5.1 Application period.** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), an encounter is covered only when the application was received no later than the application period counted from that encounter's first post-discharge statement date. Count calendar days starting the day after the encounter's first statement date; an application received on the last day of the application period itself is inside the period, and an encounter with no statement yet is always inside it. The evidence is Riverbend's own record of the encounter's first statement date and the case's application date, not the patient's recollection.

**5.2** An application received outside the period for every open encounter is denied for the reason "outside application period".

**5.3 Service area.** Where residency is required, a patient whose county of residence is not among the service area counties is eligible only for emergency encounters (emergency services being exempt from residency); if no eligible encounter remains, the application is denied for the reason "outside service area".

**5.4** An application whose only open encounters are elective non-covered services is denied for the reason "elective services only".

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, period of 240 days)

| First statement date | Application received on | Day count | Inside? |
|---|---|---|---|
| a given day D | the 240th calendar day after D | day 240 | yes (the last day itself counts) |
| a given day D | the 241st calendar day after D | day 241 | no |
| no statement issued yet | any day | — | yes |

The period is applied encounter by encounter: one application may be inside the period for one encounter and outside it for another, and only when it is outside for every open encounter is the application denied under 5.2.
